content.rendered:
A poem by the Anniversary couples friend says it all.
Dancing until the wee hours of the morning overlooking the Farm in the Country. Also uplights around the palm trees and chicken pen, Swimming pool.We could have kept going all night until the cows come home.The groom used to serve our country in the US Navy and used to write letters to his beautiful bride and it would make his day when he was on duty in a far away country when he recieved a letter.

May 3rd Robert Schulze – Oakdale, CA 95361
6:00 PM to 12:00 AM

Happy Anniversary.
